# NEW 2026-11-19 round 7 C5, Bulgaria, Moldavia and Cilicia 1341-1396 (oe_nb_). Generated by gen_neighbours.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly: the main-line scheduler oe_ml_monthly calls it (gen_mainline_lock.py, line 9 nb).
oe_nb_monthly = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_nb_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
    oe_nb_lapse = yes
    # months since the Count of Savoy's crusade (oe_br.8) for oe_nb.7
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_br_done_8 NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_7 } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_br8_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_br8_m value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_nb_br8_m add = 1 }
    }
    oe_nb_wed_check = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ml_free = yes NOT = { oe_nb_all_set = yes } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_1 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_1 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 1 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 2 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_3 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_3 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 3 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_4 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_4 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 4 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_5 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_5 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 5 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 6 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 7 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_8 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_8 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 8 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_9 = yes } random = { chance = oe_nb_ch_9 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 9 } } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_10 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 10 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 0 oe_nb_ready_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_pick value = 11 } }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 1 } oe_nb_world_1 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_1 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.1 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.2 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 3 } oe_nb_world_3 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_3 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.3 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 4 } oe_nb_world_4 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_4 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.4 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_5 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.5 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 6 } oe_nb_world_6 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_6 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.6 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 7 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_7 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.7 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 8 } oe_nb_world_8 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_8 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.8 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 9 } oe_nb_world_9 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_9 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.9 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_10 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.10 }
        if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_pick = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_11 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.11 }
        remove_variable = oe_nb_pick
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Marks events that can no longer come (state 2); oe_nb.9 is skipped (state 3) when Cilicia is our subject.
oe_nb_lapse = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_9 } current_date >= 1375.1.1 country_exists = c:CIL c:CIL = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_9 value = 3 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_safe value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_safe value = 1 } }
    }
    oe_nb_mol_void_check = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_1 } oe_nb_lapse_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_2 } oe_nb_lapse_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_3 } oe_nb_lapse_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_4 } oe_nb_lapse_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_5 } oe_nb_lapse_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_6 } oe_nb_lapse_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_7 } oe_nb_lapse_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_7 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_8 } oe_nb_lapse_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_8 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_9 } oe_nb_lapse_9 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_9 value = 2 } }
}
# BYZ scope. patch296 (V-02, decision 296-2): oe_nb.4 lapses because no Moldavia exists after its window; the reason is
# kept as result oe_nb_mol_void (read by the test readout mlnbmol). The lapse itself is the line below in oe_nb_lapse.
oe_nb_mol_void_check = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_4 } oe_nb_mol_never = yes } set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_mol_void value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_mol_void value = 1 } } }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The Bulgarian match: marry the two once both are 14 (if the engine has not already).
oe_nb_wed_check = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_nb_groom has_variable = oe_nb_bride NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_wed_done } }
        var:oe_nb_groom = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_g }
        var:oe_nb_bride = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_b }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:oe_nb_g = { is_alive = yes is_married = no age_in_years >= 14 }
                scope:oe_nb_b = { is_alive = yes is_married = no age_in_years >= 14 }
            }
            scope:oe_nb_b = { marry_character_ignore_blocks = scope:oe_nb_g }
            set_variable = { name = oe_nb_wed_done value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    scope:oe_nb_g = { OR = { is_alive = no is_married = yes } }
                    scope:oe_nb_b = { OR = { is_alive = no is_married = yes } }
                }
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_nb_wed_done value = 1 }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_nb.1: Leo IV is killed by the nobles (1341.8.28), only while Cilicia is AI.
oe_nb_world_1 = {
    if = {

        kill_character = character:cil_leo_iv
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_leo4_killed value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_leo4_killed value = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_nb.3: Vidin becomes a tsardom under Ivan Sratsimir, vassal of Bulgaria (as vanilla flavor_bul.2 a).
oe_nb_world_3 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_nb_cond_3 = yes }
        character:bul_ivan_sratsimir = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_sra }
        c:BUL = { create_country_from_cores_in_our_locations = c:VID }
        c:VID ?= {
            set_new_ruler = scope:oe_nb_sra
            make_subject_of = { target = c:BUL type = subject_type:vassal }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_vidin_split value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_vidin_split value = 1 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. oe_nb.4: Moldavia leaves Hungary and Bogdan takes the throne (only while Moldavia and Hungary are AI).
oe_nb_world_4 = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_nb_cond_4 = yes }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:HUN c:MOL = { is_subject_of = c:HUN } }
            c:HUN = { cancel_subject = c:MOL }
        }
        if = {
            limit = { c:MOL = { is_subject = no } }
            c:MOL = {
                create_character = {
                    first_name = name_bogdan
                    female = no
                    age = 50
                    culture = culture:moldovan
                    religion = religion:orthodox
                    estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                    save_scope_as = oe_nb_bogdan
                }
                set_new_ruler = scope:oe_nb_bogdan
            }
            set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_mol_free value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_mol_free value = 1 } }
        }
    }
}

        c:VID = { make_subject_of = { target = c:HUN type = subject_type:vassal } }

    }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_nb.9: branch 1 the empire guarantees Cilicia (no world effect, the event decides); otherwise Sis falls.
oe_nb_world_9 = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CIL giving_scripted_relation = { target = c:CIL type = relation_type:guarantee } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_branch value = 1 }
    }
    else = { oe_nb_cil_fall = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. The fall of Sis: Corycus to Cyprus (theirs since 1361), the rest of Cilicia to the Mamluks; only while
# Cilicia, the Mamluks (and Cyprus for Corycus) are AI. Branch 2 when it happened, 3 when a player is involved (news only).
oe_nb_cil_fall = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CIL country_exists = c:MAM c:CIL = { is_ai = yes NOT = { is_subject_of = c:BYZ } } c:MAM = { is_ai = yes } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:CYP c:CYP = { is_ai = yes } location:corycus = { owner ?= c:CIL } }
            location:corycus = { change_location_owner = c:CYP }
        }
        c:MAM = { annex_country = { country = c:CIL reason = MilitaryConquest transfer = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_fell value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_fell value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_branch value = 2 }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_branch value = 3 } }
}

# BYZ scope. oe_nb.2: the eldest suitable son of the emperor, else of the heir (scope:oe_nb_groom).
oe_nb_pick_groom = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { any_child = { oe_nb_groom_ok = yes } } }
        ruler = { ordered_child = { limit = { oe_nb_groom_ok = yes } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_nb_groom } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_heir = yes heir = { any_child = { oe_nb_groom_ok = yes } } }
        heir = { ordered_child = { limit = { oe_nb_groom_ok = yes } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_nb_groom } }
    }
}
# BUL scope, scope:oe_nb_groom set. The tsar's eldest suitable daughter, else a new one named Keratsa (scope:oe_nb_bride).
oe_nb_pick_bride = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_ruler = yes ruler = { any_child = { oe_nb_bride_ok = yes } } }
        ruler = { ordered_child = { limit = { oe_nb_bride_ok = yes } order_by = age_in_days position = 0 check_range_bounds = no save_scope_as = oe_nb_bride } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_ruler = yes }
        ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_tsar }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_nb_tsar = { is_female = no has_dynasty = yes } }
            create_character = {
                first_name = name_keratsa
                female = yes
                father = scope:oe_nb_tsar
                dynasty = scope:oe_nb_tsar.dynasty
                culture = culture:bulgarian
                religion = religion:orthodox
                age = oe_nb_bride_age
                save_scope_as = oe_nb_bride
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_nb_tsar = { is_female = no } }
            create_character = {
                first_name = name_keratsa
                female = yes
                father = scope:oe_nb_tsar
                culture = culture:bulgarian
                religion = religion:orthodox
                age = oe_nb_bride_age
                save_scope_as = oe_nb_bride
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_nb_tsar = { has_dynasty = yes } }
            create_character = {
                first_name = name_keratsa
                female = yes
                mother = scope:oe_nb_tsar
                dynasty = scope:oe_nb_tsar.dynasty
                culture = culture:bulgarian
                religion = religion:orthodox
                age = oe_nb_bride_age
                save_scope_as = oe_nb_bride
            }
        }
        else = {
            create_character = {
                first_name = name_keratsa
                female = yes
                mother = scope:oe_nb_tsar
                culture = culture:bulgarian
                religion = religion:orthodox
                age = oe_nb_bride_age
                save_scope_as = oe_nb_bride
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Fires the hidden worker oe_nb.90 with job $j$ (option effects stay out of the option previews).
oe_nb_run_job = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_nb_job value = $j$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.90
}
# 11: Guy of Lusignan goes east and takes the Cilician throne.
oe_nb_job_guy = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CIL c:CIL = { is_ai = yes } oe_nb_guy_here = yes }
        character:cil_konstandin_ii_lusignan = { move_country = c:CIL }
        c:CIL = { set_new_ruler = character:cil_konstandin_ii_lusignan }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_guy value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_guy value = 1 } }
    }
}
# 21: the Bulgarian bride comes to Constantinople; betrothed (married at once if both are 14; the monthly check
# marries them later if the engine cannot betroth them).
oe_nb_job_bride = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_nb_cand_groom ?= { is_alive = yes } var:oe_nb_cand_bride ?= { is_alive = yes } }
        var:oe_nb_cand_groom = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_g }
        var:oe_nb_cand_bride = { save_scope_as = oe_nb_b }
        scope:oe_nb_b = {
            if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
            set_variable = { name = oe_nb_bul_bride value = 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_groom value = scope:oe_nb_g }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_bride value = scope:oe_nb_b }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_nb_g = { age_in_years >= 14 } scope:oe_nb_b = { age_in_years >= 14 } }
            scope:oe_nb_b = { marry_character_ignore_blocks = scope:oe_nb_g }
            set_variable = { name = oe_nb_wed_done value = 1 }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_nb_b = { can_betroth_character = scope:oe_nb_g } }
            scope:oe_nb_b = { create_betrothal = scope:oe_nb_g }
        }
        c:BUL ?= { add_truce_with = { target = c:BYZ years = 10 mutual = yes } }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_bul_wed value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_bul_wed value = 1 } }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nb_cand_groom } remove_variable = oe_nb_cand_groom }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_nb_cand_bride } remove_variable = oe_nb_cand_bride }
}
# 51: the raid on Anchialos (dice roll oe_nb_raid_chance); the result notice oe_nb.91 reads var oe_nb_res.
oe_nb_job_raid = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_nb_roll value = 0 }
    random = { chance = oe_nb_raid_chance set_variable = { name = oe_nb_roll value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_nb_roll = 1 country_exists = c:BUL c:BUL = { is_ai = yes owns = location:anhialo } }
        location:anhialo = { change_location_owner = c:BYZ }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 511 }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_nb_roll = 1 country_exists = c:BUL }
        add_casus_belli = { target = c:BUL type = casus_belli:cb_conquer_province province = location:anhialo.province years = 10 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 512 }
    }
    else = {
        add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 513 }
    }
    c:BUL ?= { add_truce_with = { target = c:BYZ years = 5 mutual = yes } }
    remove_variable = oe_nb_roll
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.91
}
# 71: the Green Count's towns: Anchialos and Burgas (standing in for Mesembria) from Bulgaria; a claim when Bulgaria is a player.
oe_nb_job_ports = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BUL c:BUL = { is_ai = yes } }
        location:anhialo = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BUL } change_location_owner = c:BYZ } }
        location:burgas = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BUL } change_location_owner = c:BYZ } }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:BUL }
        add_casus_belli = { target = c:BUL type = casus_belli:cb_conquer_province province = location:burgas.province years = 10 }
    }
    c:BUL ?= { add_truce_with = { target = c:BYZ years = 5 mutual = yes } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_ports value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_ports value = 1 } }
}
# 91: the plea in Cairo (40%): Cilicia is spared, or Sis falls.
oe_nb_job_cairo = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_nb_roll value = 0 }
    random = { chance = 40 set_variable = { name = oe_nb_roll value = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_nb_roll = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_saved value = 1 } c:BYZ ?= { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_cil_saved value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 911 }
    }
    else = {
        oe_nb_cil_fall = yes
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nb_cil_fell } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 912 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_nb_res value = 913 } }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_nb_roll
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.91
}
# 92: the guarantee is withdrawn and Sis falls.
oe_nb_job_withdraw = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CIL giving_scripted_relation = { target = c:CIL type = relation_type:guarantee } }
        remove_relation = { type = relation_type:guarantee first = c:BYZ second = c:CIL }
    }
    oe_nb_cil_fall = yes
}

# Test helper (dev page, BYZ scope): runs event $n$'s world effect (its own AI checks still apply) and fires the event,
# without the window, the roll or the lock.
oe_nb_test_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_nb_tn value = $n$ }
    if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 1 } oe_nb_world_1 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_1 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.1 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_2 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.2 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 3 } oe_nb_world_3 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_3 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.3 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 4 } oe_nb_world_4 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_4 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.4 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_5 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.5 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 6 } oe_nb_world_6 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_6 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.6 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 7 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_7 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.7 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 8 } oe_nb_world_8 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_8 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.8 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 9 } oe_nb_world_9 = yes set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_9 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.9 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 10 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_10 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.10 }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_nb_tn = 11 } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_11 value = 1 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_nb.11 }
    remove_variable = oe_nb_tn
}

    oe_nb_mol_void_check = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_nb_st_4 } oe_nb_lapse_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_nb_st_4 value = 2 } }
    oe_nb_log_mol = yes
}
